answers.question: I ran way more than the plan and felt fine. Can I keep this up?
answers.answer:
You can keep this up if you respect recovery and keep total mileage in the 45‑50 mile range.

If you feel fine and sleep well, adding a single quality session next week will help you hit the 3:45 goal.

He should keep the volume reasonable, ensure recovery, and add one quality session next week to build speed for the target 3:45 marathon.

Next week we add a single quality block and keep the long run moderate, avoiding two hard days in a row. The plan follows build‑phase priorities: ~45‑50 mi total, one quality run, long run with marathon‑pace segments, rest days respected. HR should stay under 150 on the long run.

Safety: no red flags, so no safety callouts.
